root: ^The visitor boards with a worn clinic token. "Night clinic, please. Do you know the road that avoids the inspection arch?"
^Ask which service road the locals use.

c-0: ^"Northern service road. The clinic checkpoint gets quiet after shift change." The visitor studies your mirror. "You are new here, right?"
c-1: ^"Quiet driver." The visitor studies your empty dashboard. "I hope you know where you are going."

arrival: ^The taxi idles outside the night clinic. The visitor looks toward the entrance.

c-0: ^"Thank you, driver. The quiet road was a kindness."
c-1: ^"Just one more breath. All right. Thank you."
